name: Cutoffs
value: The policies only guarantee A− at 90, B− at 80 and C− at 70. Other letters are at the instructor's discretion, and the scale may move down but will not move up.

name: Weights
value: The policies say these are approximate and may be adjusted. They do not split the 48% for midterms, so the three exams are weighted equally here.

name: Assignments
value: Problem Sets, Discussion and Comprehension Quizzes are each one average percent, because the policies do not give the number of assignments.

name: Missed exam
value: With an excused absence, the Final replaces the missed exam, so enter your Final score for that exam.
